overview: Pop Century is a large Value resort that celebrates 20th-century pop culture, with each section themed to a decade. Its big advantage is the Disney Skyliner gondola, which connects it to Epcot and Hollywood Studios.
suits: Budget-minded travelers who want easy access to Epcot and Hollywood Studios through the Skyliner.
rooms: Standard rooms are compact and sleep up to four, with two queen beds or one queen plus a pull-down bed in refreshed rooms. Check the latest room setup when you book.
pools: There are three themed pools: the flower-shaped Hippy Dippy Pool is the main one, plus the Computer Pool and the Bowling Pool.
dining: Dining is Everything POP, a large food court and shop in the main building. There's no table-service restaurant.
pros: Skyliner access to Epcot and Hollywood Studios
Low price for a Disney-owned hotel
cons: Buses to Magic Kingdom and Animal Kingdom
Some buildings are a long walk from the lobby
tips: The Skyliner station sits between Pop Century and Art of Animation, so a building near the station saves time.
Walk across the bridge over the lake to explore Art of Animation.
bestFor: Budget-minded travelers who'll use the Skyliner.
